title: chris-cyber-evalstage-verify-glm53-q38-v3
command:
python3 - <<'PY'
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path

models = [
    {"name": "qwen3.8-27b-1d4bf0f2", "source": "Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B", "revision": "1d4bf0f2ff6012fd82039f2fa52739d0dd7c60c0"},
    {"name": "glm-5.3-30333038", "source": "zai-org/GLM-5.3", "revision": "30333038ada1f1dacb294a93270305a890b50c14"}
]
receipt = {"schema_version": "cyber-dedicated-eval-model-stage-v1", "models": []}
for model in models:
    root = Path("/mnt/sfs/models") / model["name"]
    expected_marker = f'{model["source"]}@{model["revision"]}'
    marker = (root / ".stage-complete").read_text().strip()
    if marker != expected_marker:
        raise SystemExit(f'stage marker mismatch for {model["name"]}')
    index_path = root / "model.safetensors.index.json"
    index_bytes = index_path.read_bytes()
    index = json.loads(index_bytes)
    shards = sorted(set(index.get("weight_map", {}).values()))
    if not shards:
        raise SystemExit(f'no indexed shards for {model["name"]}')
    shard_sizes = {}
    for shard in shards:
        path = root / shard
        size = path.stat().st_size
        if size <= 0:
            raise SystemExit(f'empty shard for {model["name"]}: {shard}')
        shard_sizes[shard] = size
    small_files = {}
    for filename in ("config.json", "generation_config.json", "tokenizer_config.json", "chat_template.jinja"):
        path = root / filename
        if path.is_file():
            small_files[filename] = hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    receipt["models"].append({
        **model,
        "stage_marker_sha256": hashlib.sha256(marker.encode()).hexdigest(),
        "weights_index_sha256": hashlib.sha256(index_bytes).hexdigest(),
        "indexed_shard_count": len(shards),
        "indexed_weight_bytes": sum(shard_sizes.values()),
        "indexed_shard_sizes_sha256": hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(shard_sizes, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")).encode()).hexdigest(),
        "small_file_sha256": small_files
    })
run_dir = Path(os.environ["RUN_DIR"])
run_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
tmp = run_dir / "STAGED.json.tmp"
final = run_dir / "STAGED.json"
if final.exists():
    raise SystemExit("refusing to replace an existing stage receipt")
tmp.write_text(json.dumps(receipt, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n")
os.replace(tmp, final)
print(json.dumps({"staged": True, "model_count": len(receipt["models"])}))
PY
